parsed.summary: The PR adds a handler for the `arg` function in `refine.py`, but it may not cover all edge cases and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The handler for `arg` does not cover all possible cases, such as when the argument is zero or when the expression is complex.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the correctness of the added handler for the `arg` function.
